notes: The provided text (catalog pages 167-169) contains the A.S. in Plumbers/Pipefitters Apprenticeship, the A.S. in Refrigeration Service Technician Apprenticeship, and the start of the Certificates of Achievement (Acoustical Installer Apprenticeship Certificate), but no section for the Plumbers/Pipefitters Apprenticeship Level I Certificate of Achievement. No requirements were recorded; the certificate section likely appears on a later page of the catalog and should be reviewed.

The A.S. in Plumbers/Pipefitters Apprenticeship requires a minimum of 40 units from a list including all non-298 closed-list courses plus a minimum of 16 units of work experience (HVACR 298, PLUMB 298, STMFT 298), Total Units: 56; these were not applied to the Level I certificate.
The A.S. section's Student Learning Outcomes and Career Information are printed for the degree, not for the Level I certificate, so they were not recorded.
